title: Bioluminescent Comb Jelly
subtitle: Metachronal Ctenes & Rainbow Light Diffraction
description: Marine ctenophore exhibiting 8 longitudinal rows of fused microscopic cilia (ctenes) beating metachronally to produce spectral rainbow optical diffraction waves.
mathNotation: \theta_{\text{cilia}}(s, t) = A_c \sin(\omega t - k s + \phi_r), \quad \lambda_{\text{diffract}}(s, t) = \lambda_0 \left[ 1 + \gamma \cos(\omega_d t - k s) \right]
